# css

CSS stands for Cascading STyle Sheets and is a language for styling HTML web pages as well other documents.

I specifically use `.scss` files ([Sass: Syntactically Awesome Style Sheets](https://sass-lang.com/)).
They have all the functionality of css files but more to make it easier.

## Files

We have set a light and dark theme for this website.
Therefore we use 2 scss files:

- [`styles_dark.scss`](/css/dark_scss.qmd) for the dark theme
- [`styles_light.scss`](/css/light_scss.qmd) for the light theme

These are designated in the [format segment of our `_quarto.yml` file](/yml/format.qmd).
